A: the hands photo is squeezed into a narrow, oddly cropped strip in the middle, and a white cloud block bites into its top-right corner. A: the label sits in the middle with about 230px of dead space above it. A: the contact copy is blown up almost to body size, which flattens the hierarchy, and the bottom block is crammed. The teal line is shifted right and 'equipment!' runs nearly into the right edge. A keeps the original's hierarchy and spacing, and the fine print stays small. A: title and tagline are stacked cleanly and readable, but the brush-stroke accent is stranded off to the left as a tiny grey fragment, the tagline runs over the glass jar, and the crop loses most of the spa products. Both are close: the maroon panel is shrunk into the middle of a wide banner, and the decorative X, slashes and circle lose their frame role and float over the busy hands. A pushes the maroon panel into the top half (y≈95–470), leaving the lower ~40% as unframed photo with the slash and circle marks floating loose. Both resizes failed the same way. The whole graphic group (turbine icon, colour triangles, lines) is shrunk into a tiny unreadable strip on the left, so the turbine, the main image, is now trivial. Both break the same way: the whole original composition (turbine icon, green/blue/red triangles, diagonal lines) is shrunk into a thumbnail-sized strip at left. Both are crude crops of the photo into a skyscraper. The face is cut down to a sliver of smile, and 'HOW IT WORKS?' sits directly on the hair and glasses, so text lands on a busy image. Both break the invite line into a narrow column of one or two words per line ("THIS / SUMMER / IN / LIVONIA"), and the dates are split into fragments ("JUNE / 8-24"). A: the headline is big and clear, but it breaks with 'KEEP' alone on the first line. Both crop the racket/ball photo down to an unreadable sliver at the left, wrap 'by submitting to' into a cramped three-line stack and crowd 'Xavier Sport Program' into the right edge. Both break up the 'HOHOHO AGENCY' wordmark and reorder it, putting HOHOHO below 'Office Secret Santa' so the brand reads backwards. A: 'HOHOHO' is shrunk to a tiny label in the top-left, far from 'AGENCY', which breaks up the brand name. In A, the headline is small and reads 'CONS TRUC TION' with stray gaps. A: a white block covers almost all of the photo, so the praying hands, the design's key image, are gone and only a black L-shaped sliver is left. A: the 'Spa Utopia' title and the 'Weekly SPA items review' subtitle sit directly on top of each other, so both are unreadable. Both have the same faults. Both break the brand lockup the same way. 'HOHOHO' is split from 'AGENCY' and placed below the 'Office Secret Santa' subtitle, so the name reads in the wrong order. Both crop the woman/mug/gift photo down to an unrecognisable sliver of sweater on the right edge, so the key imagery is lost, and white text (the headline, 'with your next cup of coffee') sits on top of the busy red knit pattern. A is slightly better. I can't tell these two apart in any way that matters. They differ only by a few pixels in vertical position. A: the headline and subline are readable and in a sensible order. But the beige brush-stroke backing has come loose and now sits awkwardly over the green dropper bottle at the far left. A: the crowd illustration is pushed against the left canvas edge and runs straight into 'NEVER/COMMITTED/IT'S' with no gutter, so the quote collides with the figures.
